analysis: Both units are BASE-side text of docs/provider/cli-reference.md, a documentation-only file. The patch excerpt (truncated) shows doc changes near head lines 743-769 adding `darkbloom update --rollback`, `--yes`, and an updated `--override-quarantine` description, plus small doc edits at head 1852 and 1859-1860 near `darkbloom autoupdate` and `beta`. No executable code changes are in this batch. The supplied base text (lines 1227-2134) covers stop/restart/status/doctor/models/benchmark/update/autoupdate/beta/fan/login/logout/enroll/unenroll/report and the exit codes. Nothing there is itself modified except the autoupdate and beta lines that moved. I found no documentation that weakens a stated control or contradicts the threat model. The update description still says bundle, binary and mlx.metallib hashes are verified before replacement (base 1840-1841). The App Attest, legacy and logout language is consistent with A-008, TB-011 and T-053. The prefix-cache status text (base 1394-1426) does not alter the T-041 posture. Open integration question: the new rollback feature (retained predecessor restore, quarantine, watchdog journaled rollback) touches T-043 (watchdog rollback authority is the same replaceable binary) and T-047-style stale-version concerns. The actual implementation (UpdateRollback.swift, SelfUpdater, watchdog) is not in this batch, and the patch excerpt is truncated. Whether the rollback verifies the retained predecessor's hash/signature, or can be used to downgrade to a revoked or unqualified build (T-054), cannot be assessed from docs alone. A reviewer of the code files should check this. No finding is raised from documentation alone.
